title: FASPE Journalism Fellowship
institution: FASPE (Fellowships at Auschwitz for the Study of Professional Ethics)
about: FASPE's 2027 journalism programme on the ethical responsibilities of journalists runs June 18 to July 2, 2027. Applications via the FASPE Submittable portal close January 3, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET; recommendation letters are due January 10, 2027.
requirements: Preference for candidates with journalistic work published or aired by a recognized news organization
Total professional experience generally not exceeding 10 years
